sections.name: File setup, stableId, CompanyPlan, AssociationInput
sections.title: Identifier builder and data shapes
sections.what: Builds a stable identifier from a kind label and a key, and defines the shapes for a company plan and an association input.
sections.why: Likely reason: the same key always gives the same identifier, so records can be matched across runs.
sections.watch_out: Changing the prefix or the hash length changes every identifier that is already stored.

sections.name: planAssociations
sections.title: Planning evidence, sources and milestones
sections.what: Turns the parsed data for one real estate project into a plan of evidence quotes, source documents, milestones and company links, each with a stable ID. It writes nothing itself. The plan is used for the preview, the save, and the check that a replay produces the same result.
sections.why: The comment says one shared plan is used for preview, commit and replay, so all three agree.
sections.watch_out: IDs are built from the text of the quote and label, so editing wording creates new records instead of updating old ones. Several dates and labels for specific projects are typed in directly, so new data for those projects will not be picked up automatically.

summary: Creates stable identifiers for real estate disclosure records, and defines the shape of the company and association data passed to the planning step.
purpose: Gives each disclosure record an identifier that stays the same across runs.
why: Likely reason: stable identifiers let the same record be matched again when the import runs again.
how: Partly visible. The identifier is built from a kind label and a key, hashed, and cut to 32 characters, with a fixed prefix. The planning function that uses these shapes is not visible.
inputs: A kind label and a key text, plus association inputs holding rows, documents, and company plans.
risks: Changing the prefix, the hash, or the length changes every identifier, so existing links break.
debug: If identifiers change between runs, check that the key is the same each time and that the hash helper from the report file has not changed.
